synopsis: The Project Management Institute (PMI) is a United States professional body [f16419]. The glossary identifies its PMBOK Guide, seventh edition (2021), as a collection of accepted practice, including rolling-wave planning and risk-register practice [f16420]. Chapter 12 attributes rolling-wave planning to PMI, consistent with the glossary’s account of the guide’s coverage [f10098, f16420]. The supplied facts establish this planning-method attribution but do not describe how PMI guidance is applied to the validation project [f10098, f16420].

relations.note: PMI’s guide includes rolling-wave planning, supporting Chapter 12’s attribution.
